decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche maritime line with long defense procurement cycles, and having just launched it the firm is likely to keep it to build on its maritime customer base despite its distance from the core offer.
The medical examination light builds on established lighting competence for institutional users and has its own web page, so a quick withdrawal after one year is unlikely.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires are a core certified product line for industrial customers in a growing market and fit the firm's LED efficiency strategy.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product close to the firm's offer, so demand is proven and keeping it costs little.
